eyebrow: Finding orphaned disks before touching anything
code:
# Azure CLI: managed disks with no attached VM
az disk list --query "[?diskState=='Unattached']" -o table

# AWS CLI: EBS volumes in 'available' (unattached) state
aws ec2 describe-volumes --filters Name=status,Values=available \
  --query "Volumes[].{Id:VolumeId,Size:Size,Created:CreateTime}"
caption: Finding orphans is a query against the inventory, not a manual hunt.
